preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 300000 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string s must have a length between 1 and 300,000.
Each string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if all(s == s[::-1] for s in strings) else any(s != s[::-1] for s in strings)
postconditions.description: If all strings are palindromes, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by a non-palindrome string.

postconditions.expression: any(len(output_string) == len(s) + 1 for s in strings)
postconditions.description: The output string must have a length of |s| + 1 for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(output_string != output_string[::-1] for output_string in output_strings)
postconditions.description: The output string must not be a palindrome.
